sn35.234:3.1: “Just as, Reverend Udāyī, the Buddha has explained, opened, and revealed in many ways how this body is not-self:
sn35.234:5.3: “If the cause and reason that gives rise to tongue consciousness were to totally and utterly cease without remainder, would tongue consciousness still be found?”
sn35.234:5.5: “In this way, too, it can be understood, ‘how consciousness is not-self.’” …
